comment: The three systems share the speed knob through fixed multipliers: halvorsen 0.75, dadras 0.5 and lorenz 0.03 (languor.cpp:99, 114, 129), so the lorenz column moves about twenty-five times slower than the halvorsen one. The shape knob is mapped separately onto each system's own usable span (languor.cpp:98, 113, 128).
